concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites) – no task creates or records checksums for raw or derived data files.
concerns.text: Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires every dataset to be checksummed and the checksum recorded under `data/`. The task list contains no entry that generates or records these checksums, violating the constitution.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 User Story 3 – no task explicitly verifies SC‑005 (computational feasibility time‑limit & memory‑constraint).
concerns.text: Spec SC‑005 defines a success criterion (time limit & memory usage). The current tasks cover SC‑001‑SC‑004 but omit any verification step for SC‑005, effectively dropping an acceptance criterion.
